Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Protean [pro] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Protean [PRO].

card.name: Protect Thine Own
card.cardText:
Requires a justicar or Inner Circle member.
Choose a non-Camarilla vampire with a capacity below 6. If the acting vampire is a member of the Inner Circle, you may choose any non-Camarilla vampire instead. If this referendum is successful, burn that vampire.

card.name: Protected Resources
card.cardText: Put this card in play. If you would burn more than 2 pool to a bleed, you burn 2 pool instead. After a minion you control successfully bleeds, burn this card.

card.name: Protection Racket
card.cardText:
Requires an Anarch.
+1 intercept, with an additional +1 intercept if the acting minion is titled.

card.name: Protracted Investment
card.cardText:
Master. Investment.
Put this card in play and move 5 blood from the blood bank to this card. You may use a master phase action to move 1 blood from this card to your pool. Burn this card when all blood has been removed.

card.name: Provision of the Silsila
card.cardText:
Only usable after a combat involving this Assamite and a minion with a contract. Only usable if this Assamite has been chosen for that contract. Only usable if the opposing minion is not ready and this Assamite is ready. Usable by a locked vampire.
This Assamite gains enough blood to reach full capacity. Burn the contract if it is still in play.

card.name: Proxy Kissed
card.cardText:
Out-of-turn. Only usable after you move a Giovanni from your uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase.
Put this card on that Giovanni and add 1 blood to them. This Giovanni gets +1 level of Potence [pot], +1 level of Fortitude [for], and +1 capacity

card.name: Psalm of the Damned
card.cardText:
[pre] Only usable during a bleed action. Burn 1 pool to get +1 bleed (limited).
[mal] Choose a minion. The chosen minion cannot play reaction cards (including [REACTION] abilities of power cards) this action. [mal] is not a Discipline.
[MAL] As [mal] above, and the chosen minion cannot block this action.

card.name: Pseudo-Blindness
card.cardText:
Only usable by a blocking vampire.
[chi] Cancel an action modifier card requiring Chimerstry [chi] or Obfuscate [obf] as it is played.
[CHI] As above, and the acting minion cannot use cards requiring Chimerstry or Obfuscate during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.

card.name: Psyche!
card.cardText:
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable if both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. Queue a combat with the opposing minion. (Not usable if there is already a combat queued. This can interrupt the resolution of an effect that ends a combat.)

card.name: Psychic Assault
card.cardText:
[aus] Strike: 1R damage. Any effect which would make damage from this strike aggravated leaves the damage normal instead. If this striking vampire is Black Hand, the damage from this strike is unpreventable.
[AUS] As above, but for 2R damage.

card.name: Psychic Projection
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[aus] Put this card on a minion you control. The minion with this card gets +2 intercept. Burn this card during your unlock phase.
[AUS] Put this card into play. Each of your minions gets +1 intercept. Burn this card during your next unlock phase.

card.name: Psychic Veil
card.cardText:
[obf] All of your vampires' actions are at +1 stealth this turn.
[OBF] All of your minions' actions are at +1 stealth this turn.

card.name: Psychomachia
card.cardText:
Only usable if an ally or younger vampire blocks, before block resolution.
[pre] Unlock this vampire, and the action ends (unsuccessfully).
[dai] The block fails, and the action continues. The blocking minion cannot attempt to block this action again.
[DAI] As [dai] above, and the blocking minion takes 1 unpreventable environmental damage.

card.name: Public Enemy
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-Red List, non-Anarch vampire.
Ⓓ Choose a non-titled, non-Red List minion who either has successfully bled for 3 or more pool since your last turn or is infernal or anarch. The chosen minion becomes Red List.

card.name: Public Trust
card.cardText:
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +2 bleed.
[PRE] As above, and if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more), add 1 blood to a vampire in your uncontrolled region.

card.name: Public Vilification
card.cardText:
Requires a titled Sabbat vampire.
Choose a ready younger vampire controlled by another Methuselah, and allocate 3 of their blood between 1 or more other vampires (including this acting vampire). Successful referendum means the blood is distributed as you chose.

card.name: Pulled Fangs
card.cardText:
Only usable at close range at the end of a round during which this minion successfully inflicted more damage than the opposing vampire. Not usable by a minion being burned or going to torpor.
Put this card on the opposing vampire; this minion inflicts 1 damage on them. The attached vampire cannot hunt; if they must hunt, they go to torpor instead. Any vampire(s) can burn this card with two +1 stealth actions. A vampire can have only one Pulled Fangs.

card.name: Pulling Strings
card.cardText:
Only usable during a referendum.
[dom] Force a younger vampire to abstain. This can cancel that vampire's votes and ballots.
[DOM] As above, but the affected vampire can be the same age or older.

card.name: Pulse of the Canaille
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[aus] For the remainder of this turn, you may look at all Methuselahs' hands.
[AUS] Put this card on the acting vampire. The vampire with this card gets +2 bleed. A vampire can have only one Pulse of the Canaille.

card.name: Punish
card.cardText:
[ACTION] +1 stealth action. Ⓓ Put this card on a vampire. You still control this card. The vampire with this card cannot gain blood. Any blood he or she gains goes to the blood bank instead. Burn this card during your next unlock phase.
[COMBAT] As [ACTION] above, but put this card on the opposing vampire as a hand strike (at strength damage) instead.

card.name: Puppeteer
card.cardText:
Wraith with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
[nec] Puppeteer can take control of an ally or a vampire with capacity 4 or less until the end of your turn as a Ⓓ action.
[NEC] As above, but Puppeteer has 2 life.

card.name: Purchase Pact
card.cardText:
Unique master. Requires a ready archbishop, priscus, cardinal or regent.
Put this card into play. When a Sabbat vampire you control is in combat with another Sabbat vampire, you may lock this card before range is determined to end combat. Any titled Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

card.name: Purification
card.cardText:
[qui][ACTION] +1 stealth action. Add 1 life to an ally who has fewer life than their starting life.
[QUI][REACTION] Only usable during an action requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre] against a minion you control. The action fails.

card.name: Purity of the Beast
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
Ⓓ Enter combat with an ally controlled by your prey. The acting vampire gets +2 strength in that combat.

card.name: Pursuit
card.cardText:
[cel] Maneuver.
[CEL] Additional strike (limited).

card.name: Pushing the Limit
card.cardText:
[pot] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +2 damage.
[POT] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +3 damage.

card.name: Putrefaction
card.cardText:
[pre] Strike: combat ends.
[thn] Strike: 1 damage. Put this card on the opposing minion. The minion with this card has -1 stealth. He or she may choose not to unlock as normal and burn this card during his or her unlock phase. A minion may have only one Putrefaction.
[THN] As [thn] above, and this minion takes 1 unpreventable damage when he or she strikes in combat or takes an action. The minion with this card may choose not to strike during the Choose Strike step of combat.

card.name: Putrescent Servitude
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[thn] Move any mortal or ghoul retainer you control to this vampire, or put this card on a mortal or ghoul ally you control. This ally gains 1 life, and he or she may play cards that require basic Potence [pot] as a vampire.
[THN] Ⓓ As above, but take any mortal or ghoul retainer or put this card on any mortal or ghoul ally and take control of that ally.

card.name: Qetu the Evil Doer
card.cardText:
Unique mummy with 3 life. 1 strength, 2 bleed.
Qetu gets 1 optional press each combat, only usable to end combat. If Qetu is burned, shuffle her into her owner's library.

card.name: Quick Exit
card.cardText:
[obf] Press, only usable to end combat.
[OBF] Strike: dodge.

card.name: Quick Jab
card.cardText:
Do not replace until after combat.
Strike: hand strike (at strength damage) with first strike. If more than 1 damage is inflicted with this strike, ignore the excess.

card.name: Quick Meld
card.cardText:
[pro] Maneuver.
[PRO] As above, and once this round, this vampire may burn 1 blood for an additional maneuver.

card.name: Quicken Sight
card.cardText:
[aus][cel] +1 intercept, with an optional maneuver in the resulting combat if this vampire successfully blocks.
[AUS][CEL] As above, but with +2 intercept.

card.name: Quickness
card.cardText:
A vampire can play only one Quickness each round.
[cel] Additional strike (limited).
[CEL] Additional strike that does not count against the limit.

card.name: Quicksilver Contemplation
card.cardText:
[aus] [REACTION] +1 intercept.
[tem] [REACTION] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
[aus][tem] [ACTION MODIFIER][REACTION] Only usable during the polling step of a political action. Force a younger vampire to abstain (this can cancel their votes and ballots).
[AUS][TEM] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable during a bleed action. +2 bleed, not counting against the limit.

card.name: Quietus
card.cardText:
Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Quietus [qui] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Quietus [QUI].

card.name: Rabble Razing
card.cardText: Successful referendum means all vampires with capacity below 4 burn 1 blood.

card.name: The Rack
card.cardText:
Unique location.
As this location is played or its controller changes, its controller chooses a ready vampire they control. During this location's controller's unlock phase, the chosen vampire can gain 2 blood. Vampires controlled by another Methuselah can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

card.name: Rafastio Ghoul
card.cardText:
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 bleed, 1 strength.
Rafastio Ghoul can play cards requiring basic Blood Sorcery [tha] as a vampire with a capacity of 3.

card.name: Raking Talons
card.cardText:
Only usable before range is determined.
For the remainder of combat, damage from this Gargoyle's hand strikes is aggravated. A vampire may play only one Raking Talons each combat.

card.name: Rampage
card.cardText: [pot] Ⓓ Burn any location. If you control the location, this is a +1 stealth action.

card.name: Random Patterns
card.cardText:
[aus][dem] [REACTION] +1 intercept.
[AUS][DEM] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable if a minion attempts to block. The blocking minion gets -1 intercept.

card.name: Rant!
card.cardText:
Requires a ready anarch. Only usable during a referendum before any votes and ballots are cast.
During this referendum, each ready anarch may burn 1 blood to gain 1 additional vote. If the referendum fails, this acting vampire takes 2 unpreventable damage.

card.name: Rapid Change
card.cardText:
[pro] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.
[PRO] [COMBAT] Strike: combat ends.

card.name: Rapid Healing
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Only usable by a vampire in torpor.
[for] The acting vampire leaves torpor. If the vampire is blocked, there is no combat. If the blocking minion is a vampire who can commit diablerie, that vampire may diablerize the acting vampire.
[FOR] As above, and the acting vampire gains 1 blood from the blood bank.

card.name: Rapid Thought
card.cardText:
[cel] Maneuver or press.
[CEL] Only usable during the choose-strike step, and only if this vampire would choose his or her strike first. Instead, the opposing minion chooses his or her strike first.

card.name: Raptor
card.cardText:
Animal with 1 life.
[ani] The employer gets +1 intercept.
[ANI] As above, and while the employer is in combat, the opposing minion's controller gets -1 hand size.

card.name: Rastacourere
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Put this card on a titled vampire. The vampire's title is worth 1 less vote during referendums, and he or she gets -1 stealth when attempting political actions. This vampire's capacity is reduced by 1. (A vampire's capacity cannot go below 1.) A vampire may have only one Rastacourere.

card.name: Rat's Warning
card.cardText:
Only usable by a locked vampire during a bleed action against you.
[ani] Unlock this vampire.
[ANI] As above, with 1 optional press during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.

card.name: Ravager
card.cardText:
Master.
Put this card on a Kiasyd. Non-changelings cannot block this Kiasyd's undirected hunt actions.

card.name: Rave
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
Move as much blood (or life) and/or equipment from the acting minion to any ready vampires you control.

card.name: Raven Spy
card.cardText:
Animal with 1 life.
[ani] The employer gets +1 intercept.
[ANI] As above, but Raven Spy has 2 life.

card.name: Ravnos Acceptance
card.cardText: Successful referendum means this card is put in play and each Ravnos can choose to become Camarilla. As any Ravnos enters play, they can choose to become Camarilla.

card.name: Ravnos Cache
card.cardText:
Unique location.
During your master phase, you can move 1 counter from your pool to this location and add 1 counter (from the blood bank) to it. Minions you control can lock this location to use those counters to pay some or all of the blood or pool cost of equipment they equip.

card.name: Ravnos Carnival
card.cardText:
Unique location.
This location comes into play with 1 counter for each Ravnos you control. Ravnos you control can use those counters to pay some or all of the blood cost of action cards they play. If this location has no counters, burn it.

card.name: Raw Recruit
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a slave.
Ⓓ Put this card in play and move a vampire in torpor to this card, face up and out of play. A vampire you control to whom this Gargoyle is enslaved can remove that vampire from the game as a +1 stealth action to turn this card into a Gargoyle with the same capacity, Fortitude [for], Potence [pot], Visceratika [vis] and flight [FLIGHT], enslaved to the acting vampire's clan and of the same sect as this Gargoyle.

card.name: Rayzeel's Song
card.cardText:
[ani] This vampire burns 1 blood to unlock an ally.
[val] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[VAL] +1 stealth action. Add 1 life from the blood bank to an ally that has fewer life than his or her starting amount.

card.name: Razor Bat
card.cardText:
Gargoyle creature with 2 life.
The Gargoyle with this retainer gets +1 intercept. When the Gargoyle with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion takes 1R damage during the initial strike resolution phase of each round, at long or close range.

card.name: React with Conviction
card.cardText: When an effect that would change control of this imbued is played or announced, you may burn this card to cancel that effect. Burn this card to cancel either an action directed at this imbued that requires Chimerstry [chi], Dementation [dem], Dominate [dom], Presence [pre], or Serpentis [ser] or a strike card that requires any of those Disciplines played by a minion opposing this imbued as it is announced. No cost is paid.

card.name: Read Intentions
card.cardText:
[aus] Press, only usable to end combat.
[AUS] Strike: dodge.

card.name: Read the Winds
card.cardText:
Do not replace until after this action.
[ani][aus] +1 intercept. This vampire does not lock for the block.
[ANI][AUS] Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire unlocks and attempts to block with +1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.

card.name: Reality
card.cardText:
[chi] Ⓓ Put this card on a younger vampire. This vampire cannot be the target of directed actions, cannot perform actions except to burn this card, cannot block and cannot cast votes or ballots. This vampire can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.
[CHI] Ⓓ Move a locked younger vampire to the uncontrolled region (breaking any temporary control effects); any cards and counters on the target vampire stay with them but are out of play as long as the target vampire remains uncontrolled.

card.name: Reality Mirror
card.cardText:
Only one Reality Mirror can be played in a game.
Play a combat card from the opposing minion's controller's ash heap as if from your hand. If the card requires a Discipline this vampire does not have, you can play the card as if this vampire had the basic level of 1 of the Discipline(s) required (if any).

card.name: The Realm of the Black Sun
card.cardText:
Unique.
Put this card in play. If your prey gains 1 or more pool during their master phase, you can gain 1 pool. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; titled vampires get -1 stealth during that action.

card.name: Reanimated Corpse
card.cardText:
Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength, 2 bleed.
[thn] Put X pathos counters on this corpse when it enters play. During your unlock phase, burn 1 pathos counter. Remove the corpse from the game if it has no pathos counters. The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude [for] as a vampire.
[THN] As above, but put 2 additional pathos counters on the corpse.

card.name: Rebel
card.cardText:
Archetype. Trifle.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once each turn, if they block a titled vampire or a political action, this vampire gains 1 blood before block resolution. A vampire can have only one archetype.

card.name: Rebirth
card.cardText:
Requires a Red List minion. Only usable when a diablerie action is successful.
No blood hunt may be called, and this vampire unlocks. A vampire can play only one Rebirth each turn.

card.name: Recalled to the Founder
card.cardText:
Gehenna. Requires 2 or more other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace as long as this card is in play.
During each Methuselah's unlock phase, if that Methuselah controls 3 or more vampires of the same clan, they burn one of those vampires. If that vampire's capacity is 6 or more, that Methuselah ignores this effect until the end of the game.

card.name: Reckless Agitation
card.cardText:
Requires an Independent or Anarch vampire with capacity 5 or more.
Allocate 6 points among two or more other Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each point allocated.

card.name: Recruiting Party
card.cardText: Each Ventrue antitribu in your uncontrolled region gains 1 blood from the blood bank.

card.name: Recruitment
card.cardText:
Master.
Search your crypt for a vampire. Show it to all players and place it face down in your uncontrolled region. Shuffle afterward.

card.name: Recruitment Exercise
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Draw 1 card from your crypt and reveal it. Add 1 blood from the blood bank to it if it is a Black Hand vampire.

card.name: Recure of the Homeland
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Only usable by a vampire in torpor. Usable by a locked vampire.
The acting vampire leaves torpor. If this action is blocked, there is no combat. If the blocking minion is a vampire who can commit diablerie, that vampire may diablerize the acting vampire.

card.name: Recurring Contemplation
card.cardText:
Only usable as the action is announced. Only one Recurring Contemplation can be played each turn.
[pre] Choose an ally. The chosen minion cannot block this action.
[tem] As [pre] above, but choose an ally or younger vampire.
[TEM] As [tem] above, and burn 1 blood to lock the chosen minion.

card.name: Red Herring
card.cardText:
Only usable if this vampire is blocked, before block resolution.
[chi] Unlock this vampire, and the action ends (unsuccessfully). If an action card was used to perform the action, return it to its owner's hand (discard down afterward). Vampires you control cannot perform the same action again this turn.
[CHI] As above, and lock the blocking minion.

card.name: Red List
card.cardText:
Requires a ready, titled, non-Red List vampire.
Ⓓ Choose a ready ally or a ready younger vampire. The chosen minion becomes Red List. That minion may not attempt to block this action.

card.name: The Red Question
card.cardText:
Requires a non-titled non-Anarch vampire.
Put this card on this vampire. This vampire is considered Anarch. Burn this card if this vampire changes sect.

card.name: Redcap Wilder
card.cardText:
Changeling with 2 life.
[myt] Vampires with capacity less than 7 must burn a blood to attempt to block the minion with this retainer.
[MYT] As above, but the cost to employ this retainer is reduced by 1 blood.

card.name: Redeem the Lost Soul
card.cardText:
Master.
Choose a vampire in your ash heap. Gain X pool, where X is half of the capacity of that vampire (round down). Remove that vampire from the game.

card.name: Redirection
card.cardText:
[dom] Only usable if a younger vampire is bleeding you, after blocks are declined. Lock this reacting vampire. Change the target of the bleed to another Methuselah other than the acting vampire's controller (that Methuselah can attempt to block).
[DOM] As above, but the acting vampire can be the same age or older.

card.name: Redistribution
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[san] This acting vampire gains a blood. Then move any amount of blood and equipment among the Blood Brothers in this circle.
[SAN] As above, and unlock this acting vampire.

card.name: Redline
card.cardText:
Master: out-of-turn.
Only usable when a blood hunt referendum passes and would burn a vampire controlled by another Methuselah. That vampire is not burned. Put this card on that vampire and take control of him or her. This vampire is independent. This vampire gets one optional press when in combat with a Camarilla vampire and can enter combat with any Camarilla vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Burn this card if the vampire changes sects.

card.name: Reform Body
card.cardText:
Only usable if this vampire would be burned. Usable by a vampire in torpor. Usable by a locked vampire.
[vic] Instead, this vampire goes to torpor.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire gains 2 blood.

card.name: Reformation
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires an Anarch.
[chi] Ⓓ Steal an equipment from your predator or prey.
[dom] Ⓓ Burn 1 blood to steal a hunting ground.
[ser] Ⓓ Put 1 corruption counter on any vampire. If the number of your corruption counters on the vampire equals or exceeds their capacity, you can burn those counters to steal the target vampire.

card.name: Regaining the Upper Hand
card.cardText: Choose a Methuselah. Successful referendum means the chosen Methuselah gets the Edge.

card.name: Regarhagan's Hold
card.cardText:
Master: out-of-turn.
Put this card in play under the control of another Methuselah during his or her unlock phase and move a reaction card from that Methuselah's ash heap to this card. The chosen reaction card costs that Methuselah's vampires an additional blood. That Methuselah may move 1 pool to this card as a master phase action. Burn this card when it has 2 pool counters. A Methuselah can have only 1 Regarhagan's Hold.

card.name: Regeneration
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Only usable by a vampire in torpor.
[for] The acting vampire gains 4 blood from the blood bank. (Remove excess blood.) If this action is blocked, there is no combat; if the blocking minion is a vampire who can commit diablerie, that vampire may diablerize the acting vampire.
[FOR] As above, but the acting vampire gains 5 blood from the blood bank.

card.name: Regenerative Blood
card.cardText:
Unique master.
Put this card on a Samedi you control. The Samedi with this card can heal 2 non-aggravated damage for each blood counter he or she burns.

card.name: Regent
card.cardText:
Title.
Put this card on a Sabbat vampire you control with capacity 8 or more to represent the unique Sabbat title of regent. Sabbat vampires can enter combat with this vampire as a Ⓓ action. If a Sabbat vampire diablerizes this vampire, move this card to the diablerist (before the blood hunt is called).

card.name: Rego Motum
card.cardText:
A vampire can play only one Rego Motum each round.
[tha] Prevent 2 damage from the opposing minion's strike.
[THA] Prevent 4 damage from the opposing minion's strike.

card.name: Reindoctrination
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
Choose a younger Gargoyle. That Gargoyle loses any existing slave status and becomes a slave to this acting vampire's clan. Take control of the Gargoyle if another Methuselah controls him or her, move the Gargoyle to your ready region, and unlock him or her.

card.name: Reinforcements
card.cardText:
Requires a titled vampire.
Choose one or more Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each chosen Methuselah chooses up to three library cards in their ash heap and shuffles them into their library. Remove this card from the game, even if the action or the referendum fails or is canceled.

card.name: Reins of Power
card.cardText:
Only one Reins of Power can be played or called in a game.
Successful referendum means each Methuselah can choose a ready vampire they control. Each Methuselah gains 6 pool, then burns pool equal to the capacity of their predator's chosen vampire.

card.name: Rejuvenate
card.cardText:
During your unlock phase, if this imbued has fewer life than his or her starting amount, he or she gains 1 life.
[ACTION] [1 CONVICTION] +1 stealth action. Add 1 blood to a vampire or 1 life to any other ally, not to exceed starting life.

card.name: Release of the Shackled Soul
card.cardText:
[nec] Ⓓ Burn an ally or retainer controlled by your prey.
[NEC] As above, with +1 stealth.

card.name: Relentless Pursuit
card.cardText:
[pot] Press.
[POT] Press, and if another round of combat starts, you get +2 hand size for the remainder of combat.

card.name: Relentless Reaper
card.cardText:
[for] Prevent 1 damage.
[thn] Press.
[THN] Only usable if both combatants are still ready and combat would end. Instead, burn 1 blood to start a new round.

card.name: Reliquary: Akunanse Remains
card.cardText:
Unique equipment.
During your unlock phase, choose Abombwe [abo], Animalism [ani] or Fortitude [for]. Until your next unlock phase, the Akunanse with this equipment has an additional level of the chosen Discipline. The Akunanse with this equipment gets +1 bleed and gains 1 capacity: he or she is one generation older.

card.name: Reliquary: Biague
card.cardText:
Equipment.
During your unlock phase, if the bearer is a ready Laibon, you may look at the top card of any Methuselah's library. If the card does not require a Discipline, show it to all players, and this Laibon may burn a blood to allow you to look at that Methuselah's hand.

card.name: Reliquary: Shango Remains
card.cardText: Choose an Assamite in your ash heap or burn 1 pool to choose an Assamite in your uncontrolled region. Remove the chosen Assamite from the game or burn this equipment. Once each turn, except during combat, if the Assamite bearer is ready, they can burn 1 blood to give you +2 hand size until the end of the turn.

card.name: Reliquary: Trinket
card.cardText:
Equipment.
If the bearer is a ready Laibon, you get +1 hand size. This Laibon may discard up to 3 cards from your hand as a +1 stealth action. A minion may have only one Reliquary: Trinket.

card.name: Remnant of the Endless Storm
card.cardText:
Unique werewolf with 5 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed. Requires a magaji.
The Remnant gets +1 strength for each life it has. The Remnant may enter combat with any minion as a Ⓓ action. If any effect does more than 2 damage to the Remnant, ignore the excess. If the Remnant has 4 or fewer life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.

card.name: Remover
card.cardText:
Master.
Put this card on a Black Hand vampire. This vampire can lock any card (including a minion) as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. A vampire can have only one Remover.

card.name: Renegade Garou
card.cardText:
Werewolf with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
Renegade Garou gets an additional strike (limited) each round and an optional maneuver each combat. He may enter combat with a minion controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. If Renegade Garou has 2 or fewer life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life from the blood bank.

card.name: Renewed Vigor
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[for] Put this card on this vampire. During your unlock phase, this vampire can burn this card to move from torpor to the ready region. A vampire can have only one Renewed Vigor.
[obe] Move a vampire from torpor to their controller's ready region.
[obe] Add enough life to an ally or retainer to reach their starting life.
[OBE] Add enough blood to another vampire to reach full capacity.

card.name: Repair the Undead Flesh
card.cardText:
+3 stealth action.
[for] Put this card on this vampire. In combat, this vampire may heal aggravated damage by burning 3 blood per point healed. Burn this card if this vampire goes to torpor.
[FOR] As above, but burn only 2 blood per point.

card.name: Repo Man
card.cardText:
Unique ghoul with 1 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
If the action to recruit Repo Man is successful, unlock the acting minion at the end of the turn. Repo Man can retrieve the first vehicle you find in your library as a +2 stealth action. You then place the vehicle on any ready minion you control who meets the requirements of the card (pay cost to equip as normal). If none of your ready minions meet the requirements of the card, the card is burned without cost. Shuffle afterward.

card.name: Repulsion
card.cardText:
[pre] Only usable as the action is announced. If this action is blocked, this vampire gets 1 optional maneuver, only usable to get to long range, during the resulting combat.
[obe] +1 stealth.
[OBE] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 stealth. Burn this card if this vampire is in torpor. This vampire cannot have or play another Repulsion.

card.name: Research
card.cardText:
Master.
Search your library for three cards (shuffle afterward) and place them face down in your research area. You may look at the cards in your research area at any time. A Methuselah may play only one Research in a game.

card.name: Resilience
card.cardText:
[for] Prevent 1 damage.
[FOR] Prevent 3 non-aggravated damage.

card.name: Resilient Mind
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[for] Put this card on this vampire. As another minion plays an action or combat card requiring Dementation [dem], Dominate [dom], Obeah [obe] or Serpentis [ser], this vampire can burn 1 blood. If they do so, that card has no effect on them.
[FOR] As above, and unlock this vampire after putting this card in play.

card.name: Resist Earth's Grasp
card.cardText:
[cel] [COMBAT] Press, or maneuver with 1 optional press.
[CEL] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.

card.name: Respire
card.cardText:
[ACTION] Ⓓ Inflict 1 damage on a vampire with capacity less than 6. If this action is successful, you may move 1 conviction [1 CONVICTION] from your hand or ash heap to this imbued.
[ACTION] [1 CONVICTION] +1 stealth action. Add 1 blood to a vampire or 1 life to any other ally, not to exceed starting life.

card.name: Resplendent Protector
card.cardText:
Mortal with 1 life.
The minion with this retainer may prevent 1 damage each combat.

card.name: Restoration
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[for] This vampire gains 2 blood.
[FOR] This vampire gains 3 blood.

card.name: Restricted Vitae
card.cardText:
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire successfully hunts.
Vampires cannot hunt unless they must hunt. Vampires who must hunt can steal 1 blood from a younger vampire as a Ⓓ hunt action.

card.name: Restructure
card.cardText:
[dem] Ⓓ Put this card on an ally. The attached ally does not unlock as normal. Their controller can burn 1 pool during their unlock phase to unlock the attached ally.
[DEM] Ⓓ Steal an ally controlled by another Methuselah.

card.name: Resume the Coil
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Only usable by a vampire in torpor. Leave torpor. If this action is blocked, there is no combat and if the blocking minion can commit diablerie, they can diablerize this acting vampire.
[NEC] Rescue a vampire from torpor.

card.name: Resurrection
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Only usable if an ally or retainer has been burned from play since your last turn.
[val] Move the ally or retainer card from your ash heap to your hand.
[obe] Move the retainer card from an ash heap to this vampire, with life equal to its starting life. If it requires a Discipline, use the basic level.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but move the ally card instead and put it in your ready region, unlocked.

card.name: Retain the Quick Blood
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[cel][qui] Put this card on this vampire. Blood this vampire spends to play cards requiring Celerity [cel] or Quietus [qui] can be put on this card instead of returning to the blood bank. During your unlock phase, you can move 1 blood from this card to this vampire.
[CEL][QUI] As above, but you can move 2 blood.

card.name: Retribution
card.cardText:
Master.
Choose a minion who successfully bled you for more than 1 pool since your last turn. The chosen minion takes 3 unpreventable damage. A Methuselah can play only 1 Retribution in a game.

card.name: The Return to Innocence
card.cardText: Ⓓ Bleed. If you successfully bleed your prey for one or more, put this card on the acting vampire. Burn this card if this vampire loses any blood or goes to torpor, or if your prey is ousted. During your next unlock, this vampire is removed from the game and your prey burns X pool, where X is the capacity of this vampire.

card.name: Reunion Kamut
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Move 2 blood from the blood bank to a Black Hand vampire in your uncontrolled region.

card.name: Revelation of Desire
card.cardText:
Only usable during a bleed action.
[ser] +1 bleed (limited).
[SER] Burn 1 of your corruption counters from a minion controlled by the target Methuselah to get +3 bleed against that Methuselah (limited).

card.name: Revelation of Despair
card.cardText:
Only usable if this vampire blocks, before block resolution.
[ser] The acting minion burns 1 blood or life.
[SER] Put 1 corruption counter on the acting minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds their capacity or cost, you can burn those counters to steal the target minion.

card.name: Revelation of Ecstasy
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[ser] Ⓓ Lock a ready minion controlled by your prey.
[SER] As above, and put 1 corruption counter on the target minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds their capacity or cost, you can burn those counters to steal the target minion.

card.name: Revelation of the Sire
card.cardText:
Requires a ready non-sterile vampire who is not Caitiff.
Put this card on a younger Caitiff. The vampire with this card is now considered to be a member of the same clan as the acting vampire. He or she is no longer considered Caitiff. His or her capacity increases by 1.

card.name: Revelation of Wrath
card.cardText:
Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which the opposing minion inflicted 2 or more damage or any aggravated damage (even if prevented). A vampire can play only one Revelation of Wrath each round.
[ser] Put 1 corruption counter on the opposing minion.
[SER] As above, and put 1 additional corruption counter if the opposing minion inflicted 3 or more damage or 2 or more aggravated damage this round.

card.name: Revelations
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[aus] Ⓓ Look at your prey's hand and discard one card of your choice from it.
[AUS] Put this card in play. Your prey plays with an open hand. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

card.name: Revenant
card.cardText:
Ghoul with 2 life.
The employer gets +1 intercept.

card.name: Reversal of Fortunes
card.cardText: Successful referendum means direction of play is reversed. Prey is still to the left, however.

card.name: Revocation of Tyre
card.cardText: Successful referendum means this card is put in play and each Assamite can choose to become Camarilla. As any Assamite enters play, they can choose to become Camarilla.

card.name: Revolutionary Council
card.cardText:
Requires a baron.
Choose X ready unlocked Anarchs you control and allocate 2X points among one or more Methuselahs, locations, and equipment. Successful referendum means each chosen Anarch is locked, each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each point allocated, and each location or equipment allocated a point is burned.

card.name: Rewilding
card.cardText: Ⓓ Burn a location and burn 2 pool from its controller.

card.name: Rewind Time
card.cardText:
[pre] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[tem] Cancel an action card as it is played (the acting minion does not lock).
[TEM] Usable even though there is no action. Cancel a non-out-of-turn master card as it is played by another Methuselah, and its cost is not paid. That Methuselah gets +1 master phase action.

card.name: Riddle Phantastique
card.cardText: Ⓓ Put this card on an ally or younger vampire who is not Malkavian or Malkavian antitribu. Put X riddle counters on this card, where X is half the capacity of the acting vampire (round down). The minion with this card burns 1 riddle counter instead of unlocking during his or her unlock phase. Burn this card when it has no counters. You may not play this card if another Riddle Phantastique is in play.

card.name: Righteous Aura
card.cardText:
Only usable if this vampire is ready and the opposing minion is not.
Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +2 bleed. Burn this card if this vampire is about to leave the ready region. A vampire can have only one Righteous Aura.

card.name: Rigor Mortis
card.cardText:
Only usable before range is determined. A minion can play only one Rigor Mortis each round.
[pre] The opposing minion cannot use any additional strikes this round.
[thn] As [pre] above, with an optional press.
[THN] As [thn] above, and once each round this combat, you may cancel a maneuver used by the opposing minion.

card.name: Riposte
card.cardText:
Not usable on the first round of combat.
[cel] Strike: combat ends, and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once combat ends if the range is close (damage not preventable).
[CEL] As above, but inflict 2 damage.

card.name: Rise of the Fallen
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires an infernal minion. Unique.
Put this card in play. Your prey burns 1 pool after resolution of each action during which you have burned corruption counters. Methuselahs can burn a vampire they control with any corruption counters during their unlock phase to burn this card.

card.name: Rise of the Nephtali
card.cardText:
Gehenna. Requires 1 or more other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until a vampire becomes a liaison.
Independent vampires can receive the unique Independent title of Liaison (worth 4 votes) as an action. If this title would be contested with a younger vampire, the younger vampire immediately yields instead of contesting.

card.name: The Rising
card.cardText:
Gehenna. Requires at least 2 other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until your prey is ousted.
A Methuselah cannot gain pool during their own turn unless they have the Edge or at least 1 victory point (instead, any pool they would gain goes to the blood bank).

card.name: Ritual Challenge
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
If this action succeeds, put this card on the acting Gangrel. This vampire gets +1 strength. A vampire may have only one Ritual Challenge card.

card.name: Ritual of the Bitter Rose
card.cardText: Each ready vampire you control gains an amount of blood from the blood bank equal to the amount of blood on a vampire being burned either by diablerie or while in combat with this vampire.

card.name: Ritual Scalpel
card.cardText:
Unique.
This Nagaraja gets +1 hunt. This Nagaraja can inflict 1 unpreventable damage on a mortal (ally or retainer) to gain 2 blood as a Ⓓ action.

card.name: Robert Carter
card.cardText:
Unique ghoul with 1 life.
During your unlock phase, Carter's employer burns 1 blood, or Carter is burned. The vampire with this retainer gets +2 bleed.

card.name: Rock Cat
card.cardText:
Gargoyle creature with 4 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
Rock Cat may enter combat with a ready minion as a Ⓓ action. Opposing vampires with capacity 3 or less cannot strike in the first round. Rock Cat gets an optional press each combat. Rock Cat may play cards requiring basic Potence [pot] as a 3-capacity vampire.

card.name: Rockheart
card.cardText:
[tha] Strike: dodge.
[vis] Prevent half the damage (round up) done by the opponent's strike. (Doing this twice would prevent all damage from the strike.)
[VIS] As [vis] above, and prevent half the damage (round up) done by each strike of the opponent for the remainder of combat. A vampire may play only one Rockheart at superior each combat.

card.name: Rogue
card.cardText:
Master: trifle.
Play on a vampire who has committed diablerie since your last turn. Any vampire can enter combat with this vampire as a Ⓓ action. Vampires with Auspex [aus] get +1 stealth on that action.

card.name: Roll
card.cardText:
Do not replace until after combat.
[FLIGHT] Maneuver. A minion may play only one Roll each round. If this minion is still ready when you would draw to replace this card, you may move this card from your ash heap to your hand instead.

card.name: Rolling with the Punches
card.cardText:
[for] Prevent 1 damage.
[FOR] Burn 1 blood to prevent all damage from the opposing minion's strikes this round.

card.name: Rom Gypsy
card.cardText:
Mortal with 2 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
Rom Gypsy may strike for 1R damage. Rom Gypsy gets one optional maneuver each combat. Lock to give a Ravnos you control +1 stealth.

card.name: Rooftop Shadow
card.cardText:
[cel] +1 intercept. Not usable if the acting minion has Celerity [cel].
[CEL] +1 intercept. Not usable if the acting minion has superior Celerity [CEL].

card.name: Root of Vitality
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[vic] Rescue a vampire from torpor.
[VIC] Add 1 life to an ally who has fewer life than their starting life.

card.name: The Rose Foundation
card.cardText:
Master: unique location.
Lock this location and burn a conviction [1 CONVICTION] from a ready imbued you control to reduce a bleed against you by one or to gain two votes in a referendum.

card.name: Rötschreck
card.cardText:
Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is locked and sent to torpor. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During this vampire's next unlock phase, burn this card.

card.name: Rowan Ring
card.cardText:
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: Send the opposing vampire to torpor. This card is transferred to that vampire, and he or she doesn't unlock as normal during the unlock phase as long as he or she remains in torpor.

card.name: RPG Launcher
card.cardText:
Weapon.
6R damage each strike; only usable after the first round of combat; only usable at long range.

card.name: Rubicon
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a titled vampire.
Ⓓ Burn a younger non-titled vampire who has burned one of your non-Red List vampires since your last turn.

card.name: Ruins of Ceoris
card.cardText:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The Tremere antitribu with this location gets an optional maneuver or press each combat.

card.name: Ruins of Charizel
card.cardText:
Unique location.
Put pool you burn to unlock infernal minions you control using the infernal trait on this card. During an action, you can burn X counters from this card to reduce a bleed against you by X. During your predator's discard phase, burn all the counters from this card.

card.name: Ruins of Villers Abbey, Belgium
card.cardText:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The vampire with this location may burn X blood before range is determined on the first round of a combat to get X optional maneuvers for that combat.

card.name: Rumble
card.cardText:
Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Ⓓ Enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another Methuselah. In that combat, your hand size is increased by one. If this acting vampire is not ready at the end of the action, you burn 1 pool.

card.name: The Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper
card.cardText:
Unique location.
You can lock this card during an action to choose a vampire; the chosen vampire can burn 1 blood to get +1 intercept during that action.

card.name: Rumors of Gehenna
card.cardText: Choose one or more Methuselahs. If this referendum is successful, put this card into play. Each chosen Methuselah receives two master phase actions during his or her master phase (instead of one). Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

card.name: Rutor's Hand
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[tha] Put this card on this vampire, locked; this vampire takes 1 unpreventable environmental aggravated damage. During your minion phase, this vampire can lock this card to unlock. A vampire can have only one Rutor's Hand.
[THA] As above, and this vampire can burn 3 blood to be immune to this aggravated damage.

card.name: Saatet-ta
card.cardText:
Unique mummy with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
During an action, Saatet-ta can lock to give a Follower of Set you control +1 stealth, +1 intercept, or +1 bleed. If she is burned, shuffle her into her owner's library.

card.name: Sabbat Inquisitor
card.cardText:
Requires a ready archbishop, cardinal or regent.
Choose a Sabbat vampire who is not an Inquisitor. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire. This vampire is an Inquisitor and gets +1 bleed. He or she may look at the top card of any Methuselah's crypt as a Ⓓ action; if it is a vampire with Blood Sorcery [tha], burn that card. Any Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

card.name: Sabbat Priest
card.cardText:
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Choose a ready Sabbat vampire. Successful referendum means that for the remainder of the game, any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood.

card.name: Sabbat Threat
card.cardText:
Requires a prince or justicar.
Choose one or more Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each chosen Methuselah gets a threat counter. Each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each threat counter he or she has during his or her unlock phase. A Methuselah may never have more than two threat counters, and he or she may burn the Edge to burn all the threat counters he or she has.

card.name: Sacrament of Carnage
card.cardText:
[pot] Strike: 2R damage.
[POT] Strike: 3R damage.

card.name: Sacré-Cœur Cathedral, France
card.cardText:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
Allies cannot block this vampire.

card.name: Sacrifice
card.cardText:
Requires a Sabbat vampire with capacity above 7.
Choose a vampire with a capacity below 7 who belongs to the same clan as the acting vampire. Successful referendum means the chosen vampire is burned.

card.name: Sacrificial Lamb
card.cardText:
[obf] Burn a vampire in torpor that you control. The acting vampire gains blood equal to the burned vampire's capacity (ignore excess blood). You may also transfer equipment from the burned vampire to this one. This action is not considered diablerie.
[OBF] Ⓓ As above, but burn a vampire in another Methuselah's torpor region.

card.name: Safe Passage
card.cardText:
[for] Allies get -1 intercept this action.
[obe] As [for] above, and reaction cards cost +1 blood or life this action.
[OBE] As [obe] above, and put this card on this vampire. Actions directed at this attached vampire cost +1 blood or life. Burn this card during your unlock phase.

card.name: Salt of Thoth
card.cardText: Usable by a locked Tremere. Cause an action directed at a location you control to fail and put this card on that location. You may burn this card to cause an action directed at this location to fail.

card.name: Samuel Haight
card.cardText:
Unique werewolf with 4 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
Once each action, Samuel may burn a life to get +1 bleed. He may steal equipment as a strike. He may play cards requiring basic Celerity [cel] or basic Blood Sorcery [tha] as a vampire. Any vampire may call a referendum to make Samuel become Red List as a +1 stealth political action. If Samuel has less than 4 life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life from the blood bank.

card.name: San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Spain
card.cardText:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The vampire with this location may steal up to 2 blood from an uncontrolled minion in your predator's uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

card.name: San Nicolás de los Servitas
card.cardText:
While in play, this equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment. Unique.
Actions directed at this Lasombra cost 1 additional pool. If this location is burned, this Lasombra takes 2 unpreventable environmental damage. This card cannot be contested. If a card would contest this location, instead it is burned.

card.name: Sanguinary Wind
card.cardText:
[cel] Only usable before strikes are chosen. This vampire's strikes may not be dodged this round.
[CEL] As above, but usable after strikes have been chosen.

card.name: Sanguine Entrapment
card.cardText:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Sanguine Entrapment each round.
[cel][qui] The opposing minion cannot strike: dodge this round.
[CEL][QUI] The opposing minion cannot strike: combat ends this round.

card.name: Sanguine Instruction
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
Choose a Discipline this vampire has at superior. Put this card on a ready vampire of the same clan as this acting vampire. The vampire with this card gains one level of the chosen Discipline. The vampire's capacity increases by 1: the vampire is one generation older. Cannot be placed on a vampire with the superior version of the Discipline.

card.name: The Sargon Fragment
card.cardText:
Unique.
This vampire gets superior Necromancy [NEC]. This vampire can move a library card from your ash heap to your hand as an action that costs 1 blood (discard down afterward).

card.name: Saturday-Night Special
card.cardText:
Weapon, gun.
1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver each combat.

card.name: Savannah Runner
card.cardText:
Requires a Laibon.
[cel] This Laibon burns 1 blood to get +1 intercept.
[CEL] Lock this Laibon or an Aye on him or her to unlock another ready Laibon. Not usable by a blocking Laibon.

card.name: Save Face
card.cardText:
Only usable by an unlocked vampire not involved in the current combat. Only usable during the press step if both combatants are still ready.
Choose a younger vampire of the same clan who is involved in the combat. The chosen vampire gets a mandatory press, only usable to continue combat. If the chosen combatant is still ready after the combat ends, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank. Only one Save Face may be played each combat.

card.name: Sawed-Off Shotgun
card.cardText:
Weapon, gun.
3R damage each strike, only usable once each combat.

card.name: Scalpel Tongue
card.cardText:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
[cel][pre] Choose a vampire who has cast votes or ballots in this referendum. The chosen vampire is locked and abstains (this cancels the chosen vampire's votes and ballots).
[CEL][PRE] As above, and the chosen vampire burns 1 blood.

card.name: Scapelli, The Family "Mechanic"
card.cardText:
Unique mortal with 3 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Scapelli may strike for 2R damage. Once each combat, Scapelli may press to continue combat.

card.name: Scarlet Lore
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Move a minion card from your ash heap to the top of your library.
[myt] Search your library for a minion card (shuffle afterward), reveal it, and move it to the top of your library.
[MYT] As [myt] above, with an additional +1 stealth.

card.name: Scattershot
card.cardText:
Ammo.
Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. This gun inflicts +2 damage at close range and -2 damage at long range each strike for the remainder of this combat. No more than one ammo card can be used on a gun each combat.

card.name: SchreckNET
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
If this Nosferatu's capacity is 6 or more, he or she unlocks. Put this card in play. Whenever a referendum succeeds, you may lock this card to look at any Methuselah's hand.

card.name: Scobax
card.cardText:
[pre] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[str] The acting minion gets -1 stealth. [str] is not a Discipline.
[STR] As [str] above, and the action fails unless the acting minion burns 1 blood or life.

card.name: Scorn of Adonis
card.cardText:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
Methuselahs casting (including controlling a minion casting) votes or ballots against the referendum burn 1 pool once results are tallied.

card.name: Scorpion Sting
card.cardText:
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[ANI] As above, and this strike cannot be dodged.

card.name: Scorpion's Touch
card.cardText:
[qui] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike and put this card on the opposing minion. The attached minion gets -1 strength (this does not affect the current strike resolution). Any vampire can burn this card as a +1 stealth action. A minion can have only one Scorpion's Touch.
[QUI] As above, and the attached minion burns 1 blood or life during their unlock phase.

card.name: Scourge
card.cardText:
Requires a titled vampire.
Choose a vampire of the same sect. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire and unlock this acting vampire. The vampire with this card may enter combat with a vampire with capacity 4 or less or with an ally as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

card.name: Scourge of Alecto
card.cardText:
Frenzy. Only usable against a vampire or werewolf.
[cel][pre] Strike: X-2 ranged damage, where X is this vampire's capacity minus the target's capacity or cost. If more than 4 damage is inflicted with this strike, ignore the excess.
[CEL][PRE] As above, with an optional maneuver.

card.name: Scourge of the Enochians
card.cardText: During your discard phase, you can burn a vampire with capacity 2 or less, and your predator takes control of this card (even if you do not burn a vampire).

card.name: Scouting Mission
card.cardText:
[dom] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[DOM] +1 stealth action. Add 2 blood to a younger vampire in your uncontrolled region.

card.name: Screw the Masquerade!
card.cardText: Choose a Methuselah. Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool and the chosen Methuselah burns an additional pool.

card.name: Scrounging
card.cardText:
+1 stealth action.
Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your library and move up to 2 of them to your hand (shuffle and discard afterward).

card.name: Scry the Hearthstone
card.cardText:
Only usable during an action directed at you (or a card you control).
[tha] +1 intercept.
[vis] As [tha] above, with 1 optional maneuver during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.
[VIS] Cancel an action card or action modifier card requiring Chimerstry [chi] or Obfuscate [obf] as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

card.name: Scrying of Secrets
card.cardText:
Only usable when this vampire successfully bleeds a Methuselah.
[aus] Look at the next 7 cards in that Methuselah's library.
[AUS] As above, and if any of those cards are action cards that can be used to bleed, that Methuselah discards your choice of one of those cards.

card.name: Seal of Veddartha
card.cardText:
Unique equipment.
Only usable by a vampire with capacity above 5. This vampire can bleed at +1 bleed as a Ⓓ action. During each of your unlock phases, put a counter on this card if it has 3 or fewer counters. The first 2 counters each grant this vampire one level of Dominate [dom]. The next 2 each grant this vampire one level of Fortitude [for]. Remove all counters from this card if another minion gains control of it.

card.name: Seattle Committee
card.cardText:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock during your master phase to make a ready non-titled, non-Anarch vampire you control Anarch.

card.name: Second Sight
card.cardText:
An imbued may burn only one Second Sight for the following effects each action.
Burn when a monster is acting to give this imbued +1 intercept for that action.
Burn when this imbued declares an action to give monsters -1 intercept for this action.

card.name: Second Tradition: Domain
card.cardText:
Requires a prince or justicar.
[REACTION] +2 intercept.
[REACTION] Only usable by a locked prince or justicar. This vampire burns 1 blood to unlock and attempt to block with +2 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.

card.name: Secret Horde
card.cardText:
Master: investment.
Put this card in play and move 2X blood from the blood bank to this card. You may use a master phase action to move 1 blood from this card to your pool. Burn this card when it has no counters.
